Testimony ofSenator Anne Carney introducing
LD 8, An Act Regarding the Term of Appointment of Judicial Officers
before the Joint Standing Committee on Judiciary January 22, 2025
Representative Kuhn and esteemed members of the Committee on Judiciary, I am Anne Carney,
proudly representing Senate District 29, which includes South Portland, Cape Elizabeth and part
of Scarborough. It is a pleasure to be with you today to introduce LD 8, "An Act Regarding the
Term of Appointment of Judicial Officers."
Current law is not clear about the start date for new judges in the Maine courts. This bill simply
clarifies the date on which the judicial seven-year term begins to avoid confusion regarding a judicial officer's tenn of appointment.
The Judicial Branch will follow me to present more specifics and I invite you to direct your
questions to them.
Thank you for allowing me the opportunity to introduce this bill.
Anne Carney
State Senator, District 29
